resolved_findings.evidence: Named exports now use AST binding names rather than line containment. Direct probe with a private declaration preceding an export on the same line returns only the seed plus export-not-supported-or-missing. Existing regression covers the private declaration following the export.
Computed keys are visited in the enclosing scope. Direct object-method and class-method probes both recover the imported key even when the method parameter uses the same name.

Function-body var declarations have a body scope separate from parameter initializers. The original multiline default-parameter probe now includes the outer imported definition and no longer resolves to the body var.

Runtime TS declarations create unsupported-definition bindings. Direct enum, namespace and import-equals probes, each seeded only at a later identifier use, return typescript-runtime-declaration-not-modeled at the use line. The selected-declaration case also passes its regression test.

The CLI rejects an output under STORE/runs/REPORT_ID with exit 1. A temporary-archive probe verified that no target file was created, every archived byte remained identical, and archive.verify still succeeds.

Markdown now includes schema, report/source binding, scan status, selected findings, generator/parser identity, aliases, limits and usage. Direct checks confirmed the actual input_sha256 and implementation_sha256 values occur in the Markdown copied by the UI.
